a2-vosotrospeninsular-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Friends at the Bar
a2-vosotrospeninsular-01.scenario: You are Carlos. In your last week in Madrid you are at a bar in Malasaña with Meg and Lucía's friends Javier and Marcos. You want to know whether the two of them live in the centre of Madrid.
a2-vosotrospeninsular-01.prompt: Ask Javier and Marcos together whether they live in the centre of Madrid.
a2-vosotrospeninsular-01.target: ¿Vosotros vivís en el centro de Madrid?
a2-vosotrospeninsular-01.english: Do you two live in the centre of Madrid?
a2-vosotrospeninsular-01.canDo: I can use the present tense of vosotros, with os and vuestro, to talk to a group of friends.

a2-vosotrospeninsular-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Come In and Sit Down
a2-vosotrospeninsular-02.scenario: You are Lucía. Your friends Javier and Marcos arrive at your flat in Madrid for the farewell evening for Carlos and Meg. You open the door.
a2-vosotrospeninsular-02.prompt: Tell Javier and Marcos to come in and sit down.
a2-vosotrospeninsular-02.canDo: I can give a group of friends instructions with the vosotros command, such as venid and sentaos.

a2-vosotrospeninsular-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Did You Do?
a2-vosotrospeninsular-03.scenario: You are Meg. At the farewell dinner in Madrid, Lucía says that Javier and Marcos spent the morning visiting the city. You want to know what they did today.
a2-vosotrospeninsular-03.prompt: Ask Javier and Marcos what they have done today.
a2-vosotrospeninsular-03.canDo: I can ask a group of friends what they have done today and what they did yesterday.

a2-vosotrospeninsular-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Something to Drink?
a2-vosotrospeninsular-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You are leaving Lucía's flat in Madrid with your friends Javier and Marcos, and you would like a drink together before the evening starts.
a2-vosotrospeninsular-04.prompt: Ask Javier and Marcos informally whether they want to have something to drink.
cues: Speak to your friends as a group
a2-vosotrospeninsular-04.english: Guys, do you want to have something to drink?
a2-vosotrospeninsular-04.canDo: I can choose vosotros for friends and ustedes for strangers when I speak to a group in Spain.

a2-vosotrospeninsular-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Welcome, Friends
a2-vosotrospeninsular-05.scenario: You are Lucía. On the farewell evening, Carlos and Meg arrive at your flat in Madrid. You greet them at the door.
a2-vosotrospeninsular-05.prompt: Welcome Carlos and Meg, tell them to come in and ask what they want to drink.
cues: Ask what they want to drink
a2-vosotrospeninsular-05.english: Come in, guys! What do you want to drink?
a2-vosotrospeninsular-05.canDo: I can use vosotros in the present, in commands and in the past at an evening with friends.

a2-vosotrospeninsular-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Photo of Hanoi
a2-vosotrospeninsular-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. At the farewell dinner in Madrid you show Javier and Marcos a photo of Hanoi on your phone.
a2-vosotrospeninsular-consolidation.prompt: Tell Javier and Marcos to look at the photo and ask whether they have ever been in Hanoi.
cues: Ask if they have ever been there
a2-vosotrospeninsular-consolidation.target: Mirad esta foto de Hanói, chicos. ¿Habéis estado alguna vez allí?
a2-vosotrospeninsular-consolidation.english: Look at this photo of Hanoi, guys. Have you ever been there?
a2-vosotrospeninsular-consolidation.canDo: I can use vosotros to talk to a group of friends in the present, in commands and in the past.
